base: Use case: logo-brand / identity-preserve. Use the attached approved game logo as the exact source and character identity reference. Produce ONE polished standalone square logo variant, not a presentation sheet. Preserve BOTH specific stylized chibi game heroes: Xiao Jie, chestnut spiky hair, large bronze-gray forehead goggles, brown eyes, vivid red scarf/hood, red/dark tactical clothes and brown backpack; Xiao Kui, voluminous hot pink high ponytail and fringe, pink-lens black forehead goggles, black over-ear headphones with pink rings, magenta eyes and black/pink tactical outfit. Their specific expressive faces and chibi proportions must match the reference. Keep the compact angular gray weapons with orange trim for him and pink trim for her. Preserve the sophisticated sharp-contour cel-shaded illustration style, controlled palette, sand-gold accents and deep midnight navy background. This is a game emblem design, centered with clean margins, no desert scenery, no unrelated props. No letters, no A, no text, no typography, no numerals, no watermark, no blood.

variants.name: 10-duo-no-reticle
variants.detail: VERSION 1 — PRECISE EDIT, REMOVE THE RETICLE ONLY. Keep the original two characters, facial identities, hair, goggles, headphones, costumes, gun designs, poses, expressions, sizes and exact overlapping composition as unchanged as possible: female in rear-left aiming left, male front-right aiming toward the viewer-right. Remove the entire surrounding gold circular aiming ring and ALL its cardinal crosshair bars and ticks, including top, right and bottom aiming markers. Seamlessly fill only those removed areas with the same midnight navy background. Retain the original muzzle flashes and the few short angular gold action streaks immediately around the guns/lower shoulders, but ensure they do NOT outline a circle or create any enclosing frame. The result is the same familiar duo as a clean free-standing character logo with no circle, no target, no badge outline. Do not redesign the characters or change their pose in this version.

variants.name: 11-duo-new-aim
variants.detail: VERSION 2 — NEW AIMING AND FIRING COMPOSITION. Faithfully redraw these same two characters in a NEW coordinated forward aiming pose. Male foreground-left, female slightly rear-right, both guns pointed diagonally toward the SAME front-left target outside the frame, both characters visibly looking along the aiming direction with focused expressions; clear two-handed weapon grip, compact dynamic shoulder-to-shoulder squad stance. Faces and signature hair/goggles/headphones/red scarf all remain readable. Replace the original circular reticle with four sparse precise angular sand-gold targeting corner brackets; no complete enclosing ring. Add two short controlled muzzle flashes along the shooting direction, tasteful minimal gold motion accents. Use strong weapon foreshortening and a clean purposeful silhouette. Clearly distinct pose and aim direction from the original, preserve the approved character identity and drawing quality.

variants.name: 12-duo-designed-badge
variants.detail: VERSION 3 — MORE GRAPHIC DESIGN, A NEW PREMIUM BADGE. Transform the same recognizable two heroes into a strongly designed compact forward-assault crest. Interlock their large expressive heads and upper bodies in a balanced asymmetrical composition, male front-right shooting forward-right and female rear-left shooting forward-left, both faithful to the source. Build a clever unified silhouette from the flowing red scarf and sweeping pink ponytail, letting these color shapes counterbalance one another. Integrate the characters into an original OPEN angular sand-gold outpost/shield contour: broad chamfered shoulders, elegant tapered base, no circular target ring. Use only two or three bold angular gold shapes and deliberate negative-space cutouts so the emblem reads at small size. A controlled diagonal slash of navy negative space separates the pair without looking like a letter. Keep character details selective and clear, no excessive spikes or clutter, no generic esports animal motif. Bold silhouette, original graphic construction, refined visual hierarchy, a cohesive and memorable game brand mark rather than an illustration inside a stock frame.
